name: Coração Acelerado
description: The musical romantic comedy tells the story of Agrado Garcia, who dreams of being a successful country singer. On the way, she meets the star João Raul, her old flame.

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: Zuzu convinces Janete to take Agrado to a music contest. Irene reminds Alaorzinho of his wedding anniversary with Zilá. Agrado has a dream about his grandmother Cecília. Jean Carlos sends a letter to Janete about their daughter. Agrado and Raul exchange lucky medals. Jean Carlos meets Agrado. Janete panics, thinking she has killed Jean Carlos. João Raul is a hit at a major concert.

videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: Mari informs Eurico that João Raul will sing at his birthday party. Eurico humiliates Agrado. João Raul asks Lucas to find Walmir, who is gambling at a gaming table. Natália talks to Agrado about João Raul. João Raul rescues Walmir. Zuzu reminisces about the time Janete performed as a singer. Agrado is invited to Eurico's birthday party.

videos.title: Chapter 3
videos.overview: João Raul sees the video of Naiane dancing to "Garrei Nessa Fada" and becomes interested. Janete calls Nora and laments to her godmother about not having seen her father in years. Naiane sends a video thanking João Raul, and they begin exchanging messages and emojis. Agrado thinks about João Raul, looking at the career clippings she kept and the bracelet he gave her at the children's contest. João Raul plays the viola with Michel.

videos.title: Chapter 4
videos.overview: Naiane celebrates João Raul's invitation, while Alaorzinho reprimands his daughter. Janete, Zuzu, and Agrado suffer another financial setback with the Caravan. Ronei is thrilled at the prospect of a business partnership with the Alaor Group. Agrado rejects Huguinho's advances, and Janete supports her daughter. Naiane vows to take revenge on Talita. Zilá recalls the time she teamed up with Jean Carlos to drive a wedge between Janete and Alaorzinho.

videos.title: Chapter 5
videos.overview: Agrado argues with Huguinho, and Leandro supports her. Alaorzinho is annoyed by João Raul's presence in his home. Agrado and Leandro become interested in each other. Naiane tells João Raul that she was present at the radio contest years ago. Tiago assures Eduarda that she will succeed as a singer. Leandro checks into the boarding house and meets Talita. João Raul speaks to Walmir about Diana/Agrado.

videos.title: Chapter 6
videos.overview: João Raul and Naiane kiss and embrace passionately in the car. Zilá tries to convince her father to sell his house and evict Rosalva and Leocádia from the property. Alaorzinho warns that he doesn't want João Raul pursuing his daughter. João Raul shows up at Naiane's window; she pulls him in, and they embrace passionately. Eliomar opens up to Nora about the death of his wife, Cecília. Talita posts a video of João Raul and Naiane in the car.

videos.title: Chapter 7
videos.overview: Olga catches Bagunça at the snack bar and tears into Eduarda. Agrado and Eduarda manage to escape the event's security guards. Naiane announces her relationship with João Raul on social media. João Raul tells Ronei he wants the freedom to choose his own repertoire. Agrado and Eduarda surprise the audience with their impromptu performance.

videos.title: Chapter 8
videos.overview: Esteban discovers his ID badge has been deactivated. Eduarda convinces Agrado to send his song to João Raul. João Raul arrives at Naiane’s house and finds a circus-like scene with the press and influencers. Walmir is gambling at a casino. João Raul feels unwell and steps outside for some fresh air. Agrado sends his song to João Raul. Naiane sneaks up behind João Raul and knocks his phone into the pool.

videos.title: Chapter 9
videos.overview: Tiago conceals the reason his bags are packed when he sees the money the girl earned by singing. Esteban confronts Naiane, and Talita records the incident. Naiane suffers negative consequences from the fallout of her argument with Esteban. Tiago runs off with Eduarda's money; she then seeks out Naiane to apply for the opening left by Esteban. Naiane forces Ronei to discard Agrado's song.

videos.title: Chapter 10
videos.overview: The police are looking for João Raul because of Walmir. João Raul falls ill, and Naiane becomes frantic. Nora offers advice to João Raul, who dreams of Diana/Agrado. Eliomar seeks out Janete. João Raul sings a song from his past and broadcasts his search for Diana/Agrado on the radio. Agrado is deeply moved upon hearing João Raul’s plea to find her. Eliomar asks Janete for forgiveness. Alaorzinho hires Leandro.

videos.title: Chapter 11
videos.overview: Agrado is moved upon hearing João Raul’s plea to find her. Eliomar asks Janete for forgiveness. Naiane becomes distraught over João Raul’s search for Diana. João Raul declares that he will end his relationship with Naiane after the festival, and Ronei gets angry. Agrado notices a line of women at João Raul’s door claiming to be Diana. João Raul remembers the small medal he left with Diana/Agrado.

videos.title: Chapter 12
videos.overview: João Raul is harsh with Agrado, who is unable to reveal their true identity to the singer. Janete tells Zuzu she wants to let go of her painful memories. Nora finds Eliomar unconscious. João Raul flees the festival, and Ronei becomes desperate. Eduarda sells her services as a singer to Ronei. Everyone searches for João Raul. Agrado performs at a bar, and João Raul sees the performance.

videos.title: Chapter 13
videos.overview: Agrado and João Raul sing together in perfect harmony. Leandro films the scene. Talita receives the video from Leandro and shares it. Naiane’s fans storm Mequetrefe, confronting João Raul and Agrado. João Raul and Agrado kiss in the rain. João invites Agrado to record a song with him at his ranch. Zilá calls Alaorzinho; he plays it cool and invites Janete out for a bite to eat.

videos.title: Chapter 14
videos.overview: João Raul states that he no longer wishes to see Diana. Agrado decides against telling him the truth. João and Agrado sing together. João proposes that he and Agrado record "Meu Destino é Você." A furious Naiane vows to harm Agrado. Zilá questions Alaorzinho about his disappearance, but he evades the subject. Naiane makes a public statement asking João Raul to return. Zilá and Janete run into each other at the hospital.

videos.title: Chapter 15
videos.overview: João Raul and Agrado are together at the ranch. Zilá argues with Janete, who lets slip that she ran into Alaorzinho. Zilá reflects on her past with Janete and how she made her sister believe she had taken Jean Carlos's life. Cinara badmouths Janete to Nora. João Raul and Agrado celebrate being together. Naiane continues her online campaign against Agrado, and Ronei and Bara admire her for it.

videos.title: Chapter 16
videos.overview: Cinara recalls Zilá’s meeting with Jean Carlos and threatens Zilá. Palhares asks for prayers for Eliomar’s health. Zilá and Naiane confront Janete about the relationship between João Raul and Agrado. Alaor feels awkward upon running into Cinara. Talita spreads the story about Naiane and Agrado, and everyone talks about it. Agrado confides in João Raul that he never knew his father.

videos.title: Chapter 17
videos.overview: Janete sends an audio message to her daughter asking for forgiveness. Ronei makes a deal with Talita for her to trash Agrado's reputation. Agrado and João Raul are mistreated at the grocery store. João Raul questions the family connection between Agrado and Naiane. Ronei argues with João Raul and calls Agrado a con artist. João Raul confronts Agrado, asking if she lied to him.

videos.title: Chapter 18
videos.overview: Agrado opens up to Eduarda. João Raul tells Naiane he does not want to rekindle their relationship. Irene grows suspicious of Cinara's behavior. Tino warns Talita about Agrado's presence at Zeca's boarding house. Luan advises João Raul not to give up on Agrado. Cinara insists she is on Zilá's side. João Raul declares his feelings to Agrado.

videos.title: Chapter 19
videos.overview: João Raul declares his feelings for Agrado and apologizes to the fans. Ronei continues to lose clients and sponsorships. João Raul arrives at the mansion with Agrado, and the "Raulianers" boo. Naiane talks to Laurinha about Duda, feeling suspicious. Esteban is shocked once again by Naiane's outfit. At the hospital, Zilá runs into Janete. Janete speaks to her father, who remains in a coma. Agrado arrives, and she leaves, saddened.

videos.title: Chapter 20
videos.overview: Eliomar wakes up from his coma and mistakes Agrado for Cecília. Everyone is moved to learn that Eliomar has awakened. Eliomar confesses that he dreams of seeing Zilá and Janete reconcile. Walmir complains to Ronei about Agrado's presence in his home. Talita and Tino catch Eduarda with Agrado. Alaorzinho opens up to Malvino about Janete. Esteban arrives in Brazil and exposes Eduarda to Naiane.

videos.title: Chapter 21
videos.overview: Esteban arrives in Brazil and exposes Eduarda to Naiane. Janete takes Eliomar home. Leandro runs into Neide. Ronei plots against Agrado and João Raul. Zuzu arrives in Bom Retorno. Leandro questions Neide about her experience at the Alaor Amaral Group and gains leads regarding Xavier. Naiane runs into Agrado.

videos.title: Chapter 22
videos.overview: Naiane accuses Agrado and Eduarda of conspiring against her. João Raul refuses to share a commercial with Naiane. Vilma and Agenor judge Janete when they see her with Alaorzinho. Agrado patches things up with Eliomar. Zeca finds Adilson's behavior toward Walmir odd. Eduarda’s presentation for Ronei is a success, but Naiane disrupts it. Agrado asks to speak with Naiane.

videos.title: Chapter 23
videos.overview: Agrado convinces Naiane to call a truce with her and João Raul. Leandro looks for Xavier. Zilá is displeased that Naiane has invited Agrado to dinner. João Raul surprises Agrado by playing her song on the radio. Rosalva overhears Zilá’s conversation with the lawyer. Agrado and João Raul arrive for dinner at the Amaral mansion.

videos.title: Chapter 24
videos.overview: Janete arrives unexpectedly at her sister's house and is surprised to see Agrado. Leandro receives a text message and reacts with concern. Alaor talks only about his late wife, scaring Ivana off. Zilá uses Cinara's herbs to seduce her husband. Janete gets a shock when she sees Alaorzinho sleeping on the sofa at Eliomar's house.

videos.title: Chapter 25
videos.overview: Zilá looks for Alaorzinho at Eliomar's house. Agrado tells Janete she needs time to forgive her mother. Alaorzinho pressures Ronei and Bara regarding business matters. Leandro asks Agrado for a ride to Goiânia. Naiane schemes against João Raul; the plane they are in simulates an emergency landing at her grandfather's farm. Janete suggests starting a cooperative with Nora, and Cinara overhears them.

videos.title: Chapter 26
videos.overview: Leandro watches Agrado's show. João Raul realizes that Naiane set things up to be alone with him. Agrado finds it odd that she cannot get in touch with João Raul. Eduarda laments that Ronei hasn't gotten back to her regarding her recording. Leandro runs into Xavier. Eliomar confronts Zilá. Malvino demands that Janete leave town. Naiane has an allergic reaction. Leandro attacks Xavier after hearing him badmouth Soraia.

videos.title: Chapter 27
videos.overview: Agrado tries to break up the fight between Xavier and Leandro. Zilá tells Eliomar she will proceed with the request to have him declared legally incapacitated. Agrado accompanies Leandro to the hospital, while João Raul looks after Naiane at the cabin. Leandro confesses to Agrado that he has a secret. Zilá confides in Cinara about Jean Carlos. Xavier warns Zilá about the investigation into Soraia.

videos.title: Chapter 28
videos.overview: Xavier tells Zilá that Leandro sought him out. Eduarda becomes charmed by Leandro. Alaorzinho uses Talita’s program to pressure Ronei, who is in despair over his company's poor results. João Raul argues with Walmir about the contract with Ronei. Zilá once again sabotages Alaorzinho’s water, and he sets out in search of Janete again.

videos.title: Chapter 29
videos.overview: Zilá once again tampers with Alaorzinho's water, and he sets out to find Janete again. Vilma tells Agenor that Zilá needs to know Alaorzinho visited Janete. Luan tries to get closer to Eduarda, who is thinking about Leandro. Zilá confronts Alaorzinho about his search for Janete. Xavier confesses his crime to Leandro. Leandro opens up to Agrado. Leandro explains his situation to Alaor and his family.

videos.title: Chapter 30
videos.overview: Leandro explains his situation to Alaor and his family in order to secure the money for Júlia's treatment. Ronei gives Eduarda advice regarding her voice. Nora asks Eliomar to keep her book of herbs safe. Alaor seeks out Leandro to make amends. Janete asks to speak with Alaorzinho. Janete asks Alaorzinho to stay away from her.

videos.title: Chapter 31
videos.overview: Alaorzinho asks Zilá for a separation. Janete announces the official launch of her cooperative. João Raul meets Janete. Zilá invites Ronei to stay at the mansion, and Alaorzinho gets annoyed.

videos.title: Chapter 32
videos.overview: Luan notices Eduarda's interest in Leandro. Zilá assures Ronei that she will prevent the businessman's failure. Alaorzinho discovers that the access road to Bom Retorno is closed and that the show Ronei was supposed to put on cannot take place. Agrado prepares to tell João Raul about their shared past, but Walmir's arrival interrupts her. Ana Castela arrives in Bom Retorno.

videos.title: Chapter 33
videos.overview: João Raul is suspicious of Leandro's intentions toward Agrado. Alaorzinho comes up with an idea to keep the show going at the club, leaving Ronei in a panic. Cinara manages to catch Alaor's attention using a fake profile on the dating site. João Raul receives a visit from Ana Castela. On stage, João Raul surprises Agrado.

videos.title: Chapter 34
videos.overview: Eduarda becomes frustrated upon realizing that Leandro is in love with Agrado. Janete agrees to dance with Palhares Leite to escape Alaorzinho's advances. Cinara seduces Alaor. Agrado and Janete make up.

videos.title: Chapter 35
videos.overview: Zilá is hurt by Alaorzinho’s coldness. Agrado tells her mother that on her wedding night, she will reveal to João Raul that she is “Diana.” Alaor arranges a meeting with “Clara.” Janete, Zuzu, and Caturama residents protest against the nautical club designed by Zilá. At Zilá’s request, Naiane posts a video defending the club. Zilá confronts Janete in the street.

videos.title: Chapter 36
videos.overview: Alaor prepares to meet Clara/Cinara, who turns the businessman down. Alaor gets closer to Zuzu. Giovana makes a pass at João Raul, but Agrado defuses the situation. Ronei assures Naiane that Giovana will target Agrado. Eliomar gathers Zilá and Janete for a talk.

videos.title: Chapter 37
videos.overview: Janete and Zilá agree to a truce. Janete finds her father dead. Nora informs Zilá and Janete that Eliomar left a will. Nora cannot find her book of herbs and accuses her granddaughter, Cinara, of stealing it. Eduarda tells Luan that her mother abandoned her on the street and she grew up in a shelter. Zilá is furious that Janete has inherited the Caturama lands.

videos.title: Chapter 38
videos.overview: Zilá tells Janete she will not give up on the Caturama lands. Ronei comes up with the idea of ​​featuring Naiane in a music video for João Raul, which bothers Alaorzinho. Agrado is outraged to discover Giovana at João Raul's house. Naiane approves of Ronei's idea. Naiane is pleased with the conflict Giovana has stirred up regarding João Raul and Agrado.

videos.title: Chapter 39
videos.overview: João Raul claims that Giovana set him up. Eduarda tells Agrado about Luan's declaration. Cinara decides to delete Clara's social media profile and devote herself to the book on herbs she stole from Nora. Agrado mentions to João Raul that he ran into Walmir gambling. Alaor is furious when he discovers Clara deleted her profile, and Cinara worries. Walmir confronts Agrado.

videos.title: Chapter 40
videos.overview: Alaorzinho reveals to Janete that he is going to separate from Zilá. Naiane and Ronei interfere in the romance between João Raul and Agrado. Janete talks to Zuzu about Alaorzinho and Zilá. Cinara vows to take revenge on Alaor using her book of herbs. João Raul questions Naiane about her intentions regarding her surprise arrival at the ranch. Leocádia and Rosalva fail to find Nora's book among Cinara's belongings.

videos.title: Chapter 41
videos.overview: Cinara finds a spell to drive a wedge between João Raul and Agrado, and Naiane celebrates. Rosinha finishes preparing meals for Zilá and Ronei, unaware that she is using Cinara's concoctions. Rosinha serves dinner, and everyone present eats, except for João Raul and Agrado. Everyone begins speaking the unvarnished truth, and Cinara deduces that Rosinha used her concoction in the soup that was served.

videos.title: Chapter 42
videos.overview: Zilá asks Ronei to leave the Amaral mansion and pressures Cinara to save her marriage to Alaorzinho. Janete, Zuzu, and Nanda visit the construction site of the cooperative's headquarters. Ronei begins filming the music video for João Raul, Agrado, and Naiane. Tom Bastos heads to the ranch. João Raul speaks with Walmir, who hides the fact that he is gambling from his son.

videos.title: Chapter 43
videos.overview: Tom Bastos is captivated by Agrado. With Cinara's help, Zilá seduces Alaorzinho. Tom Bastos asserts that Agrado should launch her career without João Raul. João Raul is annoyed by Tom's proposal to Agrado. Agrado decides to proceed with her album as a duo with João Raul but agrees to have Tom Bastos as her manager. João Raul and Agrado argue, while Tom, Ronei, and Naiane are thrilled by the success of their plan.

videos.title: Chapter 44
videos.overview: João Raul and Agrado decide to release solo albums. Alaor and Marcela meet at a restaurant. João Raul worries because he cannot reach Walmir, who is placing new bets with Adilson. Zilá, Naiane, and Alaorzinho have a family dinner, which bothers Janete. Eduarda’s show at Mequetrefe is a hit. Agrado sees Walmir arrive home accompanied by Adilson and an armed man.

videos.title: Chapter 45
videos.overview: Eduardo and Luan celebrate the show's success and end up together. Walmir begs Agrado not to tell João Raul what she saw. Talita interviews Agrado and João Raul about the album launches. Agrado discovers that João Raul spent the night with Naiane and kept it a secret. Alaorzinho pressures Janete about Jean Carlos, and she reveals that the encounter was non-consensual.

videos.title: Chapter 46
videos.overview: Agrado asks for shelter for her mother. Zeca tells Eduarda that her show was a success; she celebrates with Luan and shows interest in him. Esteban insists on taking credit for his creations to help Zilá. Talita announces the end of the relationship between Agrado and João Raul. Naiane seeks out Agrado. Alaorzinho is annoyed to see Palhares close to Janete and ends up assaulting the radio host.

videos.title: Chapter 47
videos.overview: Adilson pressures Walmir, who fears being found out by João Raul. Naiane seizes the opportunity to get close to João Raul again, pretending to be his friend. Zilá deduces that Alaorzinho got into a fight over Janete. Agrado catches Walmir handing a trophy stolen from João Raul to Adilson and speaks with her ex-boyfriend. Palhares visits the Caturama region. João Raul begs Agrado for another chance.

videos.title: Chapter 48
videos.overview: João Raul and Agrado are talking. The "Marias de Fibra" are invited to take part in a fashion event in São Paulo. Naiane is surprised when she visits João Raul and runs into Agrado. Alaor and Marcela flirt. Naiane travels with Cinara. Zilá gets annoyed when she discovers she will be participating in the fashion show alongside Janete's cooperative.

videos.title: Chapter 49
videos.overview: João Raul accidentally sees Agrado dressed as a bride. Janete has a bad feeling. Talita hides to spy on Agrado and João Raul's movements. Laurinha discovers that Esteban is Benedito Boaventura. Naiane is distraught when she sees the photo of Agrado dressed as a bride. Agrado runs into Leandro at the airport and is spotted with him. João Raul feels jealous of Agrado being with Leandro. Naiane seeks out Ronei to talk about João Raul.

videos.title: Chapter 50
videos.overview: Naiane, Ronei, and Talita plot against Agrado; they recognize Leandro. Naiane discovers Leandro's connection to her family's business group. Zeca hires Eduarda for a series of performances at his bar. Alaorzinho becomes suspicious when Zilá and Naiane conclude that Leandro and Agrado are plotting against his family. João Raul confronts Agrado about his connection to Leandro.

videos.title: Chapter 51
videos.overview: João Raul sees a recording of the kiss between Leandro and Agrado and breaks up with his girlfriend. João Raul gets into a car accident. Ronei and Walmir go to the hospital where João Raul is. Janete and Eduarda support Agrado. Wesley offers to manage Eduarda's career, and Luan celebrates. Naiane worries about João Raul's condition. Agrado has a dream about Eduarda.

videos.title: Chapter 52
videos.overview: Agrado decides to focus on her career. Cinara is distraught when Alaor introduces Marcela as his girlfriend. João Raul tells Luan that he will now focus on his career. Agrado and Janete face a backlash from João Raul's fans. Janete defends her daughter. Eduarda celebrates the signing of a concert contract in Goiânia with Luan. Alaor advises Alaorzinho to forget Janete.

videos.title: Chapter 53
videos.overview: Palhares takes Agrado in. Nora fears she will no longer be able to see clients without her book. Eduarda steals from Zeca to advance money to Wesley for his supposed show. Ronei and Walmir enjoy seeing João Raul talking to Flavinha. Eduarda invites Agrado to sing at the bar. Zeca finds his bar destroyed and discovers his money has been taken. Tom ends his professional partnership with Agrado.

videos.title: Chapter 54
videos.overview: Janete kicks Tom out of her house to defend Agrado. Zeca threatens to call the police. Eduarda leaves for Goiânia. Agrado is distraught over the reaction of João Raul's fans. Eduarda realizes she has fallen victim to Wesley's scam. Zilá badmouths Janete and Agrado to Alaorzinho. Alaorzinho confronts Janete. Naiane gets closer to João Raul.

videos.title: Chapter 55
videos.overview: Alaorzinho sees Janete kiss Palhares. Zeca reveals that he did not report Eduarda. Palhares pays tribute to Janete on the radio. Cinara tries to warn Zilá about Marcela and asks to be her right-hand woman. Eduarda tries to convince Agrado to tell João Raul about their past. Luan questions João Raul about his feelings for Agrado. Naiane runs into Eduarda at João's house.

videos.title: Chapter 56
videos.overview: Eduarda throws Naiane off the scent. Rosalva uses Nora’s concoction in Cinara’s juice and finds the book of herbs. Naiane questions Ronei and Walmir about the possibility that Agrado is Diana. Zilá deduces that the medal João Raul had kept belonged to Cecília. Cinara dreams about Nora and discovers that the book of herbs is missing. Zilá comes up with an idea to bring Naiane and João Raul closer together.

videos.title: Chapter 57
videos.overview: Zilá explains her plan to Cinara, Naiane, and Ronei. Marcela finds it odd when Alaor and Zuzu act awkwardly around each other. Zilá lies to Naiane, claiming that Janete caused Jean Carlos's death in an accident. Irene notices a change in Leocádia's behavior. Naiane seeks out Agrado.

videos.title: Chapter 58
videos.overview: Naiane blackmails Agrado. Janete suspects something is wrong with her daughter. Agrado confides in Zuzu about Naiane's blackmail and insists to her godmother that Janete must not find out. Bara notices that Ronei is suffering over Zilá. João Raul confides in Luan. Agrado gives in to Naiane's blackmail. Prompted by Zuzu, Eduarda confesses to Agrado that she was the one who revealed his secret to Naiane.

videos.title: Chapter 59
videos.overview: Agrado asks Eduarda for some time apart. Cinara is hurt by Alaor when she notices he has removed Branca's portrait from the wall. Naiane celebrates with Zilá the success of her plan to impersonate Diana in Agrado's place. Zuzu talks to Alaor. Luan insists on helping Eduarda, who says she needs to step away for a while. Janete and Palhares spend time together as a couple. Agrado goes to João Raul's house.

videos.title: Chapter 60
videos.overview: Agrado returns João Raul's ring, and the two argue again. Naiane is thrilled with Ronei's efforts to bring her closer to João Raul. Agrado and Zuzu spot João Raul with Naiane. Zuzu meets Malvino. Agrado runs into Eduarda working at a bar. Ronei makes a pass at Zilá. Rosalva decides to brew another tea to influence Leocádia. Ronei comes up with an idea on how to be persuasive.

videos.title: Chapter 61
videos.overview: Ronei has an idea on how to convince João Raul that Naiane is the girl from his past. Janete and Zuzu help Zeca spread the word about the closing of his bar. Ronei, Bara, Zilá, and Naiane prepare to put their plan into action. Janete sings at Zeca's bar, and Alaorzinho is bothered by it. Naiane posts a fake video about Diana on her social media.

videos.title: Chapter 62
videos.overview: João Raul tries to speak with Naiane. Rosalva confesses that she took Nora's book but reveals that she no longer has it. Esteban works compulsively. Naiane talks to João Raul, who is astonished by the details she reveals about his history with Diana. Eduarda finds Naiane's voice odd and speaks to Agrado. Agrado and Eduarda decide to form a "sertanejo" duo.

videos.title: Chapter 63
videos.overview: João Raul believes Naiane but maintains that he is still attached to Agrado. Malvino is impressed by Zuzu. Irene is skeptical of the story Naiane tells about her past with João Raul. Laurinha refuses to play along with Esteban's double game. Agrado decides to auction off her wedding dress to raise funds and travel with Eduarda. João Raul seeks out Agrado.

videos.title: Chapter 64
videos.overview: Agrado confronts João Raul and announces her trip to Goiânia. João Raul gets into a bar fight. Eduarda and Agrado set up a social media page and leave for Goiânia. Palhares confesses his feelings to Janete. Zilá celebrates reconciling with Alaorzinho, while Ronei feels jealous. Janete watches a video of Naiane and seeks out Zilá.

videos.title: Chapter 65
videos.overview: Janete confronts Alaorzinho and demands that Zilá and Naiane stay away from Agrado. Cinara tells Zilá about the conversation she overheard between Janete and Alaorzinho. Eduarda and Agrado complain about the apartment they rented in Goiânia. Janete announces to Zuzu that she wants to buy Zeca's bar. Eduarda and Agrado write their first song. Agrado and Eduarda manage to perform at a barbecue restaurant.

videos.title: Chapter 66
videos.overview: Janete is shocked to learn from Paraguaio, the owner of Mequetrefe, that Alaorzinho has topped the offer to buy the bar. Agrado and Eduarda receive a proposal from a producer. Janete accepts Palhares's help. Alaor catches Walmir with Adilson. Ronei consults Nora, who prescribes a tincture to ward off his fears and anxiety. Alaor asks Marcela to get engaged.

videos.title: Chapter 67
videos.overview: João Raul gives Naiane the slip, despite feeling attracted to her. Alaorzinho is annoyed by Ronei's confidence. Zilá is shaken by Ronei's attempts to seduce her. Paraguaio seeks out Alaorzinho and says that Palhares has topped his offer for the bar. Zeca tells Alaor about Alaorzinho's intentions in buying the bar. Agrado is working as a waitress when she runs into João Raul and Naiane at the bar.

videos.title: Chapter 68
videos.overview: Naiane humiliates Agrado, leaving João Raul embarrassed. Alaorzinho arrives at Janete and Palhares's bar. Ronei declares his feelings for Zilá and kisses her. Agrado challenges João Raul, and Naiane feels jealous. Palhares points out Janete's behavior in front of Alaorzinho. To protect Esteban, Laurinha reveals to Janete and Zuzu that she is Benedito Boaventura. Eduarda believes she saw her mother.

videos.title: Chapter 69
videos.overview: Eduarda confesses to Agrado that returning to Goiânia makes her fear her past with her mother. Walmir advises João Raul to give Naiane another chance. Leandro runs into Agrado. videos.overview: Talita posts a photo of Eduarda and Leandro together at the hotel in Brasília, and Ronei feels faint. Agrado confronts Eduarda about Leandro. Laurinha scolds Malvino for trying to control her every move. Janete celebrates the success of the fashion show and thanks Alaorzinho. Ronei proposes a plan for Zilá to take revenge on Janete and Alaorzinho.

videos.title: Chapter 141
videos.overview: Ronei discovers that Zilá has met Soraia, Leandro's mother. Everyone is talking about the situation involving Agrado, Eduarda, and Leandro. Naiane rejoices at the rift between the friends. Janete supports Agrado. Nora explains to Cinara that the effects of the tea given to Palhares will soon wear off, and encourages her granddaughter to be with the young man. Ronei is shocked by Eduarda's intentions.

videos.title: Chapter 142
videos.overview: Agrado and Eduarda patch things up and decide to travel together. Ronei and Zilá trick Cinara into handing over Nora’s book of herbs. Ronei grows suspicious of Osmar. Zilá plots to sabotage Zuzanete’s entry in the juice festival. João Raul invites Irene to dinner in an attempt to bring her and Walmir back together. Cláudio asks Rosinha for help preparing the dinner for Irene and Walmir. Gael and Naiane get together.

videos.title: Chapter 143
videos.overview: Agrado, Eduarda, and Leandro decide to resume their musical partnership. Everyone arrives at the juice festival at Zuzanete, unaware that Osmar is hiding in the kitchen at Zilá's behest. Talita arrives at Zuzu and Janete's bar. Osmar sabotages only one type of juice made by Janete and Zuzu, much to the annoyance of Zilá and Ronei. Everyone begins to show symptoms after drinking the sabotaged juice. Agrado declares her love for João Raul.

videos.title: Chapter 144
videos.overview: Leandro and Eduarda finally get together. Agrado remembers kissing João Raul and is surprised. Talita praises Zuzanete on social media, while Ronei and Zilá are outraged by the failure of their plan. Ronei asks Naiane for help in convincing João Raul to go on the cruise.

videos.title: Chapter 145
videos.overview: To everyone's surprise, João Raul and Agrado agree to go on the cruise. Janete and Alaorzinho celebrate their love. Naiane is annoyed by the harmony among Eduarda, Leandro, João Raul, and Agrado. Naiane apologizes to Alaor for having kicked him out of the mansion. Janete decides to attend the dinner organized by Zilá at the Alaor Group to welcome Talita.

videos.title: Chapter 146
videos.overview: Zilá lashes out at Janete and Alaorzinho. Cinara tries to calm Zilá down. Tino and Esteban exchange compliments. Talita has an allergic reaction during the dinner Zilá prepared, and Alaor takes her to the hospital. Ronei scolds Zilá for her obsession with Janete. Laurinha feels unwell, and Esteban becomes suspicious. Naiane and Gael grow closer at the farm, but he falls ill, thwarting her plans.

videos.title: Chapter 147
videos.overview: Naiane feels left out by the way Ronei is handling the promotion for the cruise. Ronei announces that João Raul will open the show for Agrado and Eduarda. Nora gives João Raul advice regarding Agrado. Zilá negotiates the rehiring of Rosalva and Leocádia. João Raul gets a new tattoo, and Walmir believes it is a tribute to Agrado. Cinara suggests a tea for Naiane to use to sabotage the duo Agrado and Eduarda.

videos.title: Chapter 148
videos.overview: João Raul and Agrado lock eyes. Leandro is harassed by fans, and Eduarda provokes her boyfriend. Gael takes Patricinha to the ship to keep Naiane company, and ends up trapped on the vessel. Naiane sabotages Agrado and Eduarda's bags. Tino eats a tampered candy and has an allergic attack. Agrado is surprised by the disappearance of his bags, and Bará becomes suspicious.

videos.title: Chapter 149
videos.overview: João Raul sings in tribute to Agrado. Walmir shares the story of his history with João Raul with Irene, who is moved. Zilá surprises Ronei. Cinara helps Naiane set another trap for Agrado and Eduarda, and Palhares grows suspicious. Gael is released from the room where he was held captive on the ship and kisses Naiane. Before taking the stage, Agrado and João Raul think about the children they once were.

videos.title: Chapter 150
videos.overview: João Raul and Agrado give in to passion. Talita dreams of Bará and wakes up startled. Laurinha reveals to Esteban that she suspects she is pregnant. João Raul and Agrado, as well as Naiane and Gael, plan romantic outings, with neither couple knowing about the other's plans.

videos.title: Chapter 151
videos.overview: João Raul is planning his wedding to Agrado, who tells her beloved that their relationship has changed. Gael and Naiane reminisce about their childhood together. Bará falls ill during the trip with Talita. Irene questions Walmir about João Raul's family background. Talita discovers that João Raul and Agrado are together, and Naiane pressures Ronei. João Raul challenges Ronei and announces to everyone that he wants to marry Agrado.

videos.title: Chapter 152
videos.overview: Agrado tells João Raul that he will have to face Ronei's wrath. Eva and Vânia tell Bará that Talita is interested in him. Alaorzinho fears that Janete won't agree to marry him. Laurinha refuses to marry Malvino. Gael declares his love for Naiane on a radio show. João Raul decides to terminate his contract with Ronei.

videos.title: Chapter 153
videos.overview: Naiane bursts into the radio station and interrupts Gael's broadcast. Gael and Naiane end up arguing; hurt by her words, he walks away. Eva and Vânia encourage Bará to pursue Talita. Talita interviews Ronei and Zilá, who publicly trash-talk João Raul. Gael decides to return to the farm, but Naiane chases after him on a bicycle. João Raul and Agrado lock themselves inside the ranch. Zilá catches Naiane with Gael.

videos.title: Chapter 154
videos.overview: Gael and Naiane spend time together, and Zilá worries. Naiane tries to create content for her social media with Gael. Talita takes action regarding Bará. Leandro receives a phone call, and Eduarda grows suspicious.

videos.title: Chapter 155
videos.overview: Leandro pressures Xavier to tell the truth about what happened to his mother in the past, but the young man deflects the question. Luan and Walmir worry about João Raul's decision to take legal action against Ronei. Alaorzinho warns Janete about Zilá's presence. Zilá thinks about Alaorzinho. Palhares convinces Cinara to move into Nora's house and help her grandmother. João Raul invites Leandro to be his music producer.

videos.title: Chapter 156
videos.overview: Alaor assures Leandro that he will uncover the person who actually ordered the crime against Soraia. Naiane celebrates Gael's success on social media. João Raul and Agrado turn against Ronei when the producer tries to stop the singer from performing with the young woman. Irene worries about Gael. Pepê Figueiredo seeks out Ronei to talk about Naiane. Eduarda claims she can help João Raul against Ronei.

videos.title: Chapter 157
videos.overview: Leandro and Alaor pressure Xavier to reveal who ordered the crime that claimed Soraia's life. Ronei sabotages João Raul. Agrado invites João Raul to stay at her house. Eduarda and Leandro bring their families together. Alaorzinho surprises Janete and asks her to move in with him. Xavier reveals to Zilá that Alaor pressured him.

videos.title: Chapter 158
videos.overview: Nora reprimands Cinara for the way she treats Ricardo. Talita celebrates the high engagement on her livestream with Bará. Zuzu overhears the doctor who treated Alaor talking about another patient and mistakenly concludes that her boyfriend is ill. João Raul tells Ronei he has decided to pay the fine to terminate their contract. Alaorzinho asks Janete to put on his mother's ring, and Zilá watches them.

videos.title: Chapter 159
videos.overview: Zilá has a fit of jealousy and accuses Janete of being a murderer in the middle of the restaurant, while Talita records the scene. Ronei claims that Zilá's resentment toward Janete could ruin everything. Alaorzinho supports Janete. Naiane confronts Zilá about her lack of self-control. Zuzu consults Nora about Alaor, unaware that she is mistaken about his health condition, and Cinara records their conversation.
